description.content: Collection Service for premium users
API for uploading a single document as a file to the Collection Service system.

header.description: (Required) Unique request identifier used as a idempotency key.

formdata.description: (Required) The document to be uploaded. Ensure the file transfer follows the specifications outlined in `RFC 7578`, which defines file transfers using the `multipart/form-data` protocol.
(Required) The size of the uploaded document in bytes.
(Required) The hexadecimal-encoded 128-bit MD5 digest of the uploaded document. This is used as a message integrity check to verify that the data received is the same as the data originally sent.
(Required) The standard MIME type and character set describing the format of the uploaded document.
(Required) Document statuses that the user will be notified about.

response.name: Document uploaded successfully.
